topic: Sun's sign and composite-modulus assertions for difference permanents, their additive-matrix extension and related identities
title: Alternative proofs for Sun's difference-permanent conjectures and Kunisky-Spielman-Yu's sign identity

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: For Sun's Conjecture 1 in OEIS A346934, COMMENTS, revision 29 (November 5, 2025), unchanged in revision 38 (October 26, 2026), we give an alternative proof of the sign consequence of Kunisky-Spielman-Yu's skew rank-two identity (arXiv:2608.28520v1, August 28, 2026, Section 5, pages 24-25) and prove the composite-modulus assertion using Marcus's expansion (arXiv:2108.02528v1, August 5, 2021, Lemma 4). The sign identity gives an equality criterion for arbitrary real inputs. For integer additive matrices of order q-1, divisibility of every permanent by q holds exactly when q is composite and q is not 4. Farhi's binomial-coefficient identity gives their exact common divisor. We also prove the immediate sum- and power-matrix consequences and identify earlier proofs of the related reciprocal assertions.
summary: Complete written proofs of both assertions of Sun's Conjecture 1, an alternative proof of the earlier skew rank-two sign identity with its equality criterion, and the exact common divisor of all additive-matrix permanents. The order-q-1 divisibility classification is precisely composite q other than 4. Earlier reciprocal solutions and elementary-symmetric expansions are explicitly credited.

posing_source.author: Zhi-Wei Sun
posing_source.locator: COMMENTS, Conjecture 1, revision 29, November 5, 2025; unchanged in revision 38, October 26, 2026
posing_source.quote: Conjecture 1: (-1)^n*a(n) > 0 for all n > 0. Also, a(n) == 0 (mod 2n+1) if 2n+1 is composite.

related_prior_results.statement: The binomial-coefficient lcm identity, from which the factorial-split gcd follows.
The equivalent elementary-symmetric expansion for per[1+u_i*v_j], with the subset-image counting proof.
The prime and nonreciprocal root-of-unity consequences.
The reciprocal root-of-unity conjecture in A346949.
A346934 Conjecture 2 with the stronger modulus p^2.
The skew rank-two matching identity whose difference-matrix specialization implies Sun's strict sign.

related_prior_results.locator: FORMULA; related formulas in A204249, A278845 and A278847
related_prior_results.statement: The displayed sequence-specific elementary and mixed-symmetric expansions.

coverage.pinned_declaration_statement: For n>=1, if 2n+1 is composite, then 2n+1 divides per[i-j] on 1,...,2n.
written_proofs: exact gcd at every order N>=0
sign matching identity and real-input equality criterion
